description: Heatmap of LDS contact residues across the six human ATG8 paralogs
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
T=pd.read_csv("LDS_residue_comparison.csv"); R=pd.read_csv("LIR_position_contact_conservation.csv")
PARAS=["MAP1LC3A","MAP1LC3B","MAP1LC3C","GABARAP","GABARAPL1","GABARAPL2"]
# which LIR position each LDS residue reads (from contact analysis)
read={}
for _,r in R.iterrows():
    for tok in str(r.contact_residues_LC3Bnum).split("; "):
        p=int(tok.strip("*")[1:]); read.setdefault(p,[]).append(r.pep_position)
T["reads"]=T.LC3B_pos.map(lambda p: ",".join(read.get(p,[])) or "flank/none")
sub=T[T.LC3B_pos.isin(read.keys())].copy().sort_values("LC3B_pos")

M=np.zeros((len(sub),6))
lab=np.empty((len(sub),6),dtype=object)
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(sub.iterrows()):
    ref=r["MAP1LC3B"][0]
    for j,p in enumerate(PARAS):
        v=r[p]
        lab[i,j]= "-" if v=="-" else v[0]
        M[i,j]= np.nan if v=="-" else (1.0 if v[0]==ref else 0.0)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,8))
ax.imshow(M, cmap="Blues", vmin=-0.3, vmax=1.4, aspect="auto")
for i in range(len(sub)):
    for j in range(6):
        ax.text(j,i,lab[i,j],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,
                color="white" if M[i,j]==1 else "#c53030")
ax.set_xticks(range(6)); ax.set_xticklabels(PARAS, rotation=40, ha="right")
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sub)))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r['MAP1LC3B']}  ({r['reads']})" for _,r in sub.iterrows()], fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("ATG8 LIR-docking-site residues that contact the LIR peptide\n(rows labelled by LC3B residue and the LIR position it reads; red = differs from LC3B)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(R.to_string(index=False))
